# ModifierKeys

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Input` · enum

```csharp
public enum ModifierKeys
```

Modifier keys held at the time a [`KeyEvent`](KeyEvent.md) was produced.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="none"></a>`None = 0` | No modifier. |
| <a name="shift"></a>`Shift = 1 << 0` | Either shift key. |
| <a name="control"></a>`Control = 1 << 1` | Either control key. |
| <a name="alt"></a>`Alt = 1 << 2` | Either alt or option key. |
| <a name="meta"></a>`Meta = 1 << 3` | Either Windows or command key. |
| <a name="capslock"></a>`CapsLock = 1 << 4` | Caps lock is on. |
| <a name="numlock"></a>`NumLock = 1 << 5` | Num lock is on. |
